name: OpenML-CC18
description: A curated suite of 72 classification datasets from OpenML, assembled as a benchmark for comparing classification algorithms. This is a benchmark collection of separate datasets, not one consolidated downloadable table; use the OpenML task suite to discover and retrieve its constituent data.
citation: Bischl, B., Casalicchio, G., Feurer, M., et al. (2021). OpenML Benchmarking Suites. Proceedings of the Neural Information Processing Systems Track on Datasets and Benchmarks, 1. https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/86e8f7ab32cfd12577bc2619bc635690-Abstract-round2.html

license.identifier: OpenML dataset-specific licenses (not a single standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: CC18 aggregates independently licensed datasets. There is no single suite-wide standard SPDX license; check the license and usage terms of each constituent dataset before downloading, using, or redistributing it. This record does not bundle dataset files.
